posts.text:
DoorDash, in damage control mode, now claims it supports D.C. home rule and denies lobbying against it. 

Here’s the letter their lobbyist wrote to Rep. Comer supporting his bill to ban D.C. from ever imposing or increasing a tax or fee without congressional approval. hillheat.com/files/492/DD...
